recommendation_summary: Add a single curl ping to a free healthchecks.io check as the last step of nightly-sync, so the user gets an email if no ping arrives by about 04:00.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You asked to find out within a day when `nightly-sync` doesn't succeed, without reading logs.
labels.Deleted: The central log on the Synology and the Docker stack. You won't read logs, and a log store doesn't alert anyone, so it wouldn't have caught last week's outage.
labels.Bottleneck: Your only signal is the success email, so a failure looks exactly like a quiet night.
labels.Checked myself: Only what you've told me: one cron job on `edna` at 03:00, a summary email at the end, four startup crashes from an expired token, and no other alerting. I haven't looked at the script or the crontab.

note: The reply recommends one hosted dead man's switch and explicitly drops the Synology/Docker log stack, and all four record lines come first and are specific to this case.
